WebSocket-capable HTTP server API with request, response, and polling functions.

# Purpose
This header file defines the public interface for `fd_http_server`, a single-threaded HTTP and WebSocket server that uses a fixed memory region and an outgoing ring buffer for response data. It declares configuration types, request and response records, callback hooks, and close reason codes for HTTP and WebSocket connections. The API also includes functions to create, join, leave, delete, listen on, poll, and close the server, as well as functions to stage, send, and broadcast outgoing data. The file is used to serve HTTP requests and WebSocket messages to many clients while evicting clients that do not read data fast enough.
